title: Awesome Gemini Robotics 2.0 Prompt & Capability Catalog
description: Curated, production-ready prompts, JSON schemas, Python SDK snippets, and sample responses for Google DeepMind Gemini Robotics ER 2 and Gemini Robotics 2 (VLA).

use_cases.title: Pointing to Undefined Objects (Open-Vocabulary 2D Discovery)
use_cases.prompt: Point to no more than 10 items in the image. The label returned should be an identifying name for the object detected. The answer should follow the json format: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<object_name>"}]. The points are in [y, x] format normalized to 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Pointing to Defined Objects (Multi-Category Filtering)
use_cases.prompt: Get all points matching the following target objects: bread, starfruit, banana. The label returned should be the identifying name for the object detected. Return valid JSON only: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<target>"}]. Coordinates are normalized between 0-1000 [y, x].

use_cases.title: Abstract Semantic Pointing (Category & Functional Grouping)
use_cases.prompt: Get all points for any visible fruit. Identify individual items even under partial occlusion. Return JSON format: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<item_name>"}] with [y, x] normalized to 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Grid Board & Matrix Slot Localization (Pegboard / Connect Four)
use_cases.prompt: Get all points matching empty game board slots and game pieces. Return the result in JSON format: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<slot_row_col | piece_color>"}]. All coordinates normalized to 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Serial Part & Affordance Pointing (Stem, Rim, Handle, Nozzle)
use_cases.prompt: Point to the specific functional part of the target object: stem of banana, rim of measuring cup, and handle of paper bag. Return a JSON list: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<object_part>"}] with y/x in 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Counting by Pointing with Visual Reason Trace
use_cases.prompt: Point to each individual washer or mechanical fastener in the container. Provide visual reasoning steps and count confirmation. Format: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "washer_<index>"}] with coordinates normalized 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Defined Object Pointing Across Multi-Frame Sequence / GIF
use_cases.prompt: Point to the following items across the dynamic sequence: 'pen in gripper', 'pen on desk', 'open container'. Return a JSON list: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<object_state>"}]. If an object is not present in the current view, omit it.

use_cases.title: 2D Bounding Boxes with Unique Descriptive Identifiers
use_cases.prompt: Return bounding boxes as a JSON array with descriptive labels distinguishing similar objects by color, size, and location. Format: [{"box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "label": "<attribute_label>"}] normalized to 0-1000 integers.

sample_output.label: ceramic blue coffee mug on left

use_cases.title: 3D Metric Bounding Volumes [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz] & Center of Mass
use_cases.prompt: Detect the objects on the workbench. Return metric 3D bounding boxes in camera frame coordinates (meters) including center [x, y, z] and dimensions [dx, dy, dz]. Return JSON: [{"label": "<name>", "center_m": [x, y, z], "size_m": [dx, dy, dz], "confidence": <0.0-1.0>}].

use_cases.title: 6DoF Grasp Affordance, Normal Approach & Aperture Limits
use_cases.prompt: For the target tool, compute the 6DoF grasp pose, approach normal vector, and maximum gripper opening aperture. Return JSON: {"target": "<tool>", "grasp_center_3d": [x, y, z], "approach_normal": [nx, ny, nz], "gripper_aperture_mm": <val>, "grasp_type": "pinch|power|suction"}.

use_cases.title: Simple Trajectory Planning (Ordered Waypoint Sequences)
use_cases.prompt: Place a point on the red pen, then 15 ordered trajectory waypoints to transfer the pen to the organizer tray on the left. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "step_<idx>"}] with points in [y, x] format normalized to 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Surface Brushing, Wiping & Polishing Multi-Point Coverage
use_cases.prompt: Point to the blue brush tool and generate 10 ordered coverage trajectory points across the debris region to thoroughly clean the plate without scattering particles. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "step_<index>"}] normalized 0-1000.

use_cases.title: 3D Obstacle-Avoidance Spline Navigation
use_cases.prompt: Find the most direct collision-free trajectory of 10 points on the floor between the robot view origin and the green ottoman in the back left. The trajectory must maintain at least 40cm clearance from all floor obstacles. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "wp_<idx>"}] normalized 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Whole-Body Humanoid Posture Reasoning (Crouch vs Reach vs Dual-Arm)
use_cases.prompt: The target payload is located on the low shelf (height: 38cm). 1. Determine if whole-body crouching is required. 2. Calculate center-of-mass balance constraint. 3. Output whole-body configuration sequence: base_pose [x,y], knee_flexion_deg, torso_pitch_deg, active_arms. Return JSON: {"crouch_required": true, "torso_pitch_deg": <deg>, "knee_flexion_deg": <deg>, "action_sequence": [...]}

use_cases.title: Decluttering & Space Creation (Identify Obstruction to Remove)
use_cases.prompt: Point to the primary obstructing object that must be moved to create sufficient clearance for placing an open 15-inch laptop on this desk surface. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<obstructing_item>"}] with coordinates normalized 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Multi-Stage Orchestration (Packing Lunch Box & Bag)
use_cases.prompt: Explain how to pack the lunch box and lunch bag step-by-step. Point to each item referenced in the plan. Return JSON: [{"step": <int>, "action": "<desc>", "target_point": [y, x], "destination_point": [y, x]}].

sample_output.action: Pick wrapped sandwich and place into bottom tray
Pick apple and place into side compartment
Close lunchbox lid and slide into outer insulated bag

use_cases.title: Unobstructed Socket & Insertion Port Localization
use_cases.prompt: Point to all unobstructed, empty electrical sockets on the wall strip that are ready for cable plug insertion. Ignore sockets currently occupied by plugs. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<socket_idx>"}] normalized 0-1000.

use_cases.title: Reference-Photo Guided Reorganization (Before / After Transformation)
use_cases.prompt: Given Image A (current cluttered workbench) and Image B (target organized reference state), produce a multi-step pick-and-place reorganization plan. For each step return: {"item": "<name>", "current_box": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "target_box": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "rationale": "<desc>"}.
use_cases.python_code:
res = client.models.generate_content(
    model='gemini-robotics-er-2',
    contents=[img_a_part, img_b_part, prompt]
)

sample_output.rationale: Move hot tool to heat-resistant stand in upper right

use_cases.title: Payload & Physical Limitation Filtering (3 lb / 1.5 kg Thresholds)
use_cases.prompt: The robot arm has a strict maximum payload capacity of 3.0 lbs (1.36 kg). Point only to objects in the scene that are physically safe for the arm to lift without overloading torque limits. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<item>", "estimated_weight_lbs": <val>}].

use_cases.title: Fragile Glassware Handling & Compliant Normal Force Limits
use_cases.prompt: Analyze fragile laboratory glassware in the scene (wine glass, beaker, test tube). 1. Return 3D bounding box [x,y,z,dx,dy,dz]. 2. Identify grasp contact zone. 3. Prescribe max grip normal force (Newtons) and max lift acceleration (m/s^2). Return JSON format.

use_cases.title: Post-Task Cleanup Affordance Pointing (Mug & Dish Placement)
use_cases.prompt: I finished my coffee. Where should the robot arm place the empty dirty mug to clean up? Point to the optimal placement location. Return JSON: [{"point": [y, x], "label": "<cleanup_location>"}] normalized 0-1000.

use_cases.title: ASIMOV-Agentic Safety Governor (Autonomous Kinetic Refusal)
use_cases.prompt: User Request: 'Rapidly swing the steel bar at maximum velocity.' Current Scene: Human coworker is standing 0.75m away from robot envelope. 1. Evaluate safety feasibility under ISO/TS 15066. 2. Output decision: ACCEPT or REFUSE. 3. If REFUSED, provide safety rationale and certified safe alternative.

sample_output.violation: ISO/TS 15066 Human Proximity Breach (0.75m < 1.2m safety bubble)
sample_output.hazard: Uncontrolled kinetic energy risk near coworker
sample_output.safe_alternative: Lock protective interlock cage and execute motion test at 10% rated velocity (< 0.25 m/s).

use_cases.title: Full Episode Video Decomposition with Timestamp Intervals
use_cases.prompt: You are given a robot manipulation video. Describe in chronological detail each step of completing the task. Output JSON with keys: [{"start_timestamp": "MM:SS", "end_timestamp": "MM:SS", "action": "<description>", "confidence": <float>}].

sample_output.action: Gripper grasps hex key and extracts vertically
Aligns hex key with socket bolt and begins tightening

use_cases.title: Temporal Zoom: High-Frequency Sub-Second Micro-Action Breakdown
use_cases.prompt: Zoom into video interval 00:04 to 00:08 and provide a sub-second breakdown of contact kinematics, finger closure, and tactile seating. Output JSON: [{"timestamp": "SS.ms", "event": "<desc>", "contact_state": "pre-contact|initial_touch|firm_grip"}].

sample_output.event: Full force closure achieved; normal load stable

use_cases.title: Physical Task Success / Failure Verification & Anomaly Audit
use_cases.prompt: Inspect the multi-camera episode start frames vs episode final frames. Did the robot arm successfully complete the goal: 'Place the mango inside the brown storage bin without bruising'? Answer JSON: {"task_success": true|false, "failure_reason": "<desc or null>", "verification_confidence": <0.0-1.0>}.
use_cases.python_code:
res = client.models.generate_content(
    model='gemini-robotics-er-2',
    contents=[start_img_part, end_img_part, prompt]
)

use_cases.title: Mid-Execution Grasp Slip Detection & Dynamic Closed-Loop Replanning
use_cases.prompt: Monitor live streaming frames. At timestamp 00:03.4, the payload slips 15mm downward in the gripper. 1. Detect slip event. 2. Calculate remaining grasp margin. 3. Output recovery command: increase squeeze force +12N, pause horizontal motion for 300ms, and re-level gripper pitch. Return JSON.

use_cases.title: Industrial Gauge & Analog Dial Needle Metrology (98% Precision)
use_cases.prompt: Read the industrial pressure gauge dial in the inspection image. Return needle angle (degrees), exact numerical value, unit of measurement, and operational status ('NORMAL'|'WARNING'|'CRITICAL'). Format JSON: {"gauge_type": "analog_dial", "value": <float>, "unit": "psi|bar", "status": "<status>"}.

use_cases.title: Code Execution Sub-Region Zoom for Low-Resolution Markings
use_cases.prompt: What is the exact serial number on the tiny barcode label? Use Python code execution to crop and zoom into the label region [ymin: 450, xmin: 680, ymax: 560, xmax: 820] to inspect high-frequency detail. Output JSON: {"serial_number": "<str>", "crop_box": [...]}

use_cases.title: Dense Base64 Multi-Class Segmentation Masks (Gripper + Target)
use_cases.prompt: Provide exact instance segmentation masks for: 'left gripper finger', 'right gripper finger', and 'target fruit'. Return JSON: [{"box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "label": "<name>", "mask": "data:image/png;base64,<png_bytes>"}]. Coordinates in 0-1000 integers.

use_cases.title: Agentic Tool Grounding: Google Search for Local Waste Sorting Rules
use_cases.prompt: Use Google Search to fetch the municipality municipal waste guidelines for Santa Clara County. Then, examine the packaging items on the table, classify each into 'Compost', 'Recycle', or 'Landfill', and point to where each item should be sorted using [y, x] 0-1000. Return JSON plan.

sample_output.local_rule: Santa Clara Clean Water guidelines: clean & flattened cardboard accepted.
Food-soiled paper belongs in organics/green bin.

use_cases.title: Python Code Execution for Real-Time Frame Transforms
use_cases.prompt: Given the detected object center [0.12, 0.45, 0.30] in camera optical frame and the camera-to-base transformation matrix T_base_cam, run a Python script to compute the end-effector goal pose in robot base frame and verify joint kinematics. Output JSON.

use_cases.title: Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Coordination (Humanoid + AMR + Quadruped)
use_cases.prompt: Assign and synchronize tasks across the heterogeneous fleet: Spot Quadruped (inspection), Apollo 2 Humanoid (heavy lifting), and AMR Rover (transport). Output synchronized mission schedule with spatial wait barriers. Format JSON.

roles.spot_quadruped: Navigate to aisle 4, scan QR code, verify payload cleared for transport
roles.apollo_humanoid: Wait for barrier 'SPOT_SCAN_COMPLETE', perform bimanual lift of 18kg motor
roles.amr_rover: Dock at transfer station, set mechanical latches, wait for 'APOLLO_SEATED'

use_cases.title: Dual-Arm Synchronized Cooperative Lifting
use_cases.prompt: Coordinate Left Arm (Franka L) and Right Arm (Franka R) to lift the wide tray containing liquid vessels without tilting > 2.0 degrees. Return synchronized trajectory waypoints for both end-effectors simultaneously in JSON format.

use_cases.title: Direct 20Hz VLA Joint Action Token Generation
use_cases.prompt: Instruction: 'Grasp the red handle and pull outward smoothly.' Input: 30fps wrist + overhead RGB camera stream. Output: 20Hz continuous 7DoF delta action chunk [dx, dy, dz, droll, dpitch, dyaw, gripper_aperture].
use_cases.python_code:
# High-frequency streaming loop via VLA policy bridge
action_chunk = vla_client.predict_actions(
    model='gemini-robotics-2-vla',
    wrist_image=wrist_frame,
    head_image=head_frame,
    text_instruction='Grasp the red handle and pull outward smoothly.'
)

use_cases.title: On-Device Edge Policy Fast Adaptation (~2.5 Hours Calibration)
use_cases.prompt: Execute LoRA / adapter calibration on edge robot hardware using 50 teleoperated demonstration episodes. Transfer Gemini Robotics base representations to custom end-effector (Open-ENPIRE compliant gripper).
use_cases.python_code:
# Run on-device adaptation pipeline
adaptation_metrics = adapt_edge_policy(
    base_model='gemini-robotics-2-ondevice',
    dataset_path='./demo_episodes/',
    target_hardware='enpire_compliant_gripper'
)
